report:
In CRANIAL MRI examination:
Technique: Axial plane FSE T2 and FLAIR T2, coronal plane FSE T1 and sagittal plane FSE T2.

Examination;
	Bone structures and subgaleal tissue within the field of view are normal.
In evaluation of craniofacial region structures; Hypertrophy is present in the right inferior and middle concha. Left maxillary retention cyst is observed. Other paranasal sinuses and mastoid air cells are normal.

	In evaluation of orbits within the field of view; globes, extraorbital muscles, retrobulbar fat tissue and optic nerves are evaluated as normal.

In posterior fossa series; 4th ventricle is in normal localization, shape, and size. Cerebellar hemispheres are observed symmetrically, gray-white matter differentiation shows no abnormality.
Brainstem structures pons and midbrain are normal.
Basal cisterns are observed as open.

	In supratentorial series; white and gray matter intensities in both hemispheres are observed as normal. Ventricular system is symmetric on midline, size compatible with age.
Basal ganglia and thalami are normal.
Cortical sulci and gyri are regular.

Impression: Brain MRI findings within normal limits.
